language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hello, I'm Kami. We're in Bikini Atoll of the Marshall Islands. The atoll is a ring-shaped chain of islands.
The Marshall Islands are in the Pacific Ocean west of Hawaii, and southeast of Japan.
In the past, a lot of science experiments were conducted here, so there are a lot of old laboratory buildings. But there are some new ones used for research and cleanup too!
Lately, I have noticed that someone has been using the equipment in the laboratory here, but it is a mystery who. Will you help me find him?
Let's start by exercising our senses, so we can be like detectives and find clues in the environment around us.

Let's start by exercising our senses, so we can be like detectives and find clues in the environment around us.
I always liked to visit the beach. Here, we'll practice the basics of our five senses: sight, hearing, touch, smell and taste.
Our senses are how we make "sense" of the environment and the objects around us.

This water is smooth and nice to touch. But because there is a lot of sand in the water here, we can't quite see through it. We can feel underwater though. Let's try to guess which objects we are touching before we bring them out of the water.
To feel things we use our hands and sense of touch. Can you help me guess which each of these things is? I will tell you how it feels and you tell me what it is.
